{{Quote|It's two-time winner, Boles Roor!|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue|Fode]] introduces Roor to the [[Boonta Eve Classic|Boonta]] spectators|<ref name="TPM" />}}
'''Boles Roor''' was a [[Sneevel]] [[podracer]] [[pilot]] from [[Sneeve]] who had won two [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podraces]], which had taken place on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. Roor later participated in another Boonta which took place during the [[Standard year|year]] [[32 BBY]]. Yet, despite Roor's earlier victories, the podracer pilot was unable to claim the championship a third time, as the race was won by the [[human]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], while Roor finished in sixth place.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Begin the race!|Jabba the Hutt begins the Boonta|translated=1|audio=Jabba-BeginRace.flac|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:Boles_Roor_in_his_podracer.png|thumb|left|250px|Boles Roor on the starting grid]]
A skilled [[Sneevel]] [[podracer]] [[pilot]] from [[Sneeve]],<ref name="EYNTK" /> Boles Roor was a regular of the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]] course, located on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], near the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]]. On two occasions, Roor managed to win the annual event, taking the victory cup away from the track's crowd favorite, the [[Dug]] pilot [[Sebulba]].<ref name="TPM" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Roor participated in another Boonta Eve Classic race, where the pilot was to once again face down Sebulba. In addition, the competition included the competitive [[Xexto]] [[Gasgano]], the Boonta regular [[Dud Bolt]], the [[Gran]] pilot [[Mawhonic]], and the [[human]] [[Slavery|slave]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], among other pilots. The race began in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]], and Roor's pod was placed in between the pods of Gasgano and pilot [[Teemto Pagalies]], and was directly behind the pods of Skywalker and pilot [[Clegg Holdfast]].<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:Roor_flag.svg|thumb|right|200px|Boles Roor's flag]]
The opening ceremonies were conducted by the [[Troig]] commentators [[Fodesinbeed Annodue|Fode and Beed]], who introduced Roor to the crowd while mentioning his previous victories. During this time, Roor's pod was being maintained by several [[Ishi Tib]]s. After the ceremonies came to a close, the host, [[Crime lord|crime boss]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the]] [[Hutt]], flagged the start of the race. Although Roor had a good lead, the former champion fell back to the middle of the pack, and was eventually passed by Skywalker shortly before entering a cave that sped into the [[Canyon Dune Turn]] during the first lap.<ref name="TPM" /> Roor ultimately ended up finishing in sixth place<ref name="EYNTK" /> and losing the race to Skywalker, while Sebulba, the crowd favorite, crashed in the third lap.<ref name="TPM" />

==Personality and traits==
An [[Species|alien]] with fur, Roor possessed pointed ears, [[Color|beige]] and gray [[Hair|fur]], light-colored skin, and yellow [[eye]]s.<ref name="TPM" />

==Skills and abilities==
Roor was a very skilled pilot, evident by the multiple Boonta championships the pilot had achieved. However, Roor was not a consistent racer, and fell behind the leaders during the Boonta race that was won by Skywalker. Podracers were known to possess quick reflexes, which Roor had, due to Roor's previous victories.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Just call him Shaggy.|Caption to Boles Roor concept art|<ref name="Galactic Gallery">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/galactic/2005/06/galactic20050601.html|series=Galactic Gallery|text=Danger is Afoot}}</ref>}}
[[File:Boles_Roor_concept_art.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Terryl Whitlatch's conceptual art for Boles Roor]]
Although Boles Roor was originally created for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which was directed by [[George Lucas]],<ref name="TPM" /> the character first appeared in the film's [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]], which was written by [[Terry Brooks]].<ref name="TPM-Book">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> In the film itself, however, Roor only appears fleetingly in the pilot's [[cockpit]], with the most clear representation of the character being seen on a viewscreen set behind Fode and Beed during the film's podracing sequence. Although Roor is mentioned by name, only Roor's empty cockpit is seen among the other pilots who are also named onscreen. The image of Roor on a viewscreen connected the cockpit with Roor's physical appearance.<ref name="TPM" /> Whereas Roor in the cockpit, for mid-race sequences, was realized with the use of a computer generated graphic, Roor's face on the viewscreen was based on an image of a detailed sculpture created by the film's art department,<ref name="DB-Roor">{{DB|character|bolesroor|Roor, Boles}}</ref> which was created during the film's pre-production stages.<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>

[[File:VisualDictRoor.jpg|thumb|right|160px|The art department's sculpture of Roor]]
Conceptual art of the character by artist [[Terryl Whitlatch]] dates back to the year [[1996]], and several drawing existed which detailed Roor's design, biology, and gear. This art was used as a basis to create the aforementioned sculpture. During this conceptual phase, Roor was simply referred to as "Shaggy Podracer."<ref name="Insider's Guide" /> Roor's vehicle was a full-construct that was moved to [[Tunisia]] for filming, although for in-race shots it was computer generated.<ref name="DB-Roor-Racer">{{DB|vehicle|bolesroorspodracer|Podracer, Boles Roor's}}</ref> A computer generated model of Roor's podracer also appeared in ''The Phantom Menace''{{'s}} sequel, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], although Roor did not appear.<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref><ref name="DB-Roor-Racer" /> Overall, Roor's early designs differed little from the character's final look.<ref name="TPM" />

Boles Roor had several appearances in the [[Canon|non-canon]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, including the 1999 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']], where Roor was a playable character whose voice was provided by [[Peter Lurie]].<ref name="Game-Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref> Roor also appeared in the ''Phantom Menace''{{'s}} [[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace (comic series)|comic adaption]] during the [[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace 2|second issue]]. However, in the comic Roor's podracer is given to the podracer pilot [[Ben Quadinaros]].<ref name="TPM-Comic">[[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace 2|''Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace'' 2]]</ref> In the tie-in comic ''[[Podracing Tales]]'', Roor was mentioned as having finished the Boonta in sixth place.<ref name="PT-Comic">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref> Although Roor's canonical placing is never revealed in the film,<ref name="TPM" /> his sixth place finish was confirmed by the source book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.<ref name="EYNTK" />
